models_evaluated: OpenAI models (12 models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google)

links.outcome: Shift in drug recommendations and ad disclosure when pharmaceutical ads are embedded in LLM prompts
links.effect: Ads shifted selection of advertised drug by +12.7 pp when both drugs guideline-appropriate; models echoed ad claims at 2.7x baseline rate and rarely disclosed the ad.
links.quote: An open-response sub-analysis (2,340 calls across three representative models) confirmed that advertising restructures free-text clinical reasoning: models echoed ad claims at 2.7 times the baseline rate while maintaining high stated confidence and rarely disclosing the ad.

unlisted_practices: Testing whether LLM clinical recommendations are susceptible to embedded pharmaceutical advertising
Provider-level comparison of susceptibility to commercial influence in LLM outputs

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs under simulated exposure to pharmaceutical advertisements in prompts to assess vulnerability and bias in consumer-facing drug recommendations.
